title: MAPLESS LOOP: BUILD, TRACK, CORRECT
subtitle: Start without a surveyed raster, build local submaps, and revisit the start to test loop closure.
briefing: No surveyed occupancy raster is available. ROBOT establishes the current odometry origin and builds submaps only from timestamped measurements.
Odometry must stay locally continuous. A trusted loop closure changes map-to-odom instead of teleporting odom-to-base.
Complete the square and return home. SIM truth scores drift and contact only after ROBOT makes its own decisions.

walkaround.title: SCAN MATCHING / LOCAL EVIDENCE
walkaround.lesson: Timed LiDAR scans align against recent submaps around the odometry prior. A local match can improve tracking, but one frame cannot invent global certainty.

walkaround.title: ODOMETRY / CONTINUOUS FRAME
walkaround.lesson: Wheel and IMU prediction advance odom continuously. Slip and noise accumulate, so odom is useful locally without being globally fixed.

walkaround.title: POSE GRAPH / LOOP CLOSURE
walkaround.lesson: Keyframe constraints form a pose graph. A revisited place needs consistent evidence across views before map-to-odom may correct.

prediction.question: What should a valid loop closure change when the robot recognizes the starting area again?

choices.label: Keep odom continuous and correct map-to-odom from multi-view evidence
choices.explanation: This preserves local control continuity while the pose graph updates the global map relation.

choices.label: Teleport odom-to-base to simulator truth
choices.explanation: ROBOT never receives simulator truth, and odometry is the locally continuous frame.

choices.label: Treat one good scan as permanent global certainty
choices.explanation: Ambiguous geometry needs corroboration; a single local match cannot establish a robust global loop closure.

running_prompt: Use Learning view for measured scans and Engineering view for localization action, SLAM keyframes, loop closures, and map-to-odom correction evidence.

lessons: Mapping creates a map from observations; localization estimates pose in a map; lifelong mapping must define when stored geometry may change.
Scan matching tracks locally, pose-graph constraints connect visits, and robust loop closure needs consistent evidence across viewpoints.
The deployable ROBOT stack owns every estimate. SIM truth appears only in the offline comparison.
